inventedEvidence.evidence: "Thanks for letting me know the fan is still running" — customer said only a faint scraping/ticking noise, "not sure its a proper whirr"; also "Thanks for letting us know about the doors staying shut" when customer said kids open the doors a lot

rationale: The assistant ran a sensible, safe sequence of basic checks and ended with a hedged, broadly correct direction (fan/damper/iced air channel) and an engineer referral, with good food-safety advice. However it misstated the customer's evidence several times (fan 'still running', doors 'staying shut', seal checked 'again') and ignored the scraping/ticking noise and weak-vent clue. It never asked about frost on the freezer back panel, actual temperatures, or the model number, and did not offer the 24h manual defrost that would have confirmed the likely defrost-system fault and given a temporary fix.
